description: This source file defines `CritterIconRenderer`, a utility for creating customized critter icons with various facial features, body parts, and badges, rendered as `NSImage`. It encapsulates the drawing logic using Core Graphics in a structured manner, including geometric calculations for placing elements.

classes.name: CritterIconRenderer
classes.description: A static utility enum providing methods to generate critter icons as NSImage objects with customizable features.

methods.name: makeIcon
methods.description: Creates an NSImage icon of a critter with customizable facial expressions, body positioning, and optional badge, based on parameters like blink, ear wiggle, and badge prominence.

methods.name: makeBitmapRep
methods.description: Generates a 36x36 pixel bitmap representation for drawing the icon, optimized for Retina displays.

methods.name: makeCanvas
methods.description: Creates a Canvas struct with dimensions and scaling based on the bitmap rep and graphics context, facilitating precise drawing.

methods.name: drawBody
methods.description: Draws the critter's body, ears, and legs in the given canvas using Core Graphics paths.

methods.name: drawFace
methods.description: Draws the face and eyes of the critter, including options for blinking, closed eyes, and ear holes.

methods.name: drawBadge
methods.description: Draws a badge (icon badge with prominence levels) on the critter, with transparency and symbol rendering.
